Damian sat on the couch in your apartment, nursing a throbbing nose and a split lip. Blood stained the tissue you pressed against his face, evidence of the scuffle he had gotten into earlier— another of the countless gang brawl he ended up involved in, probably about territory and selling drugs. honestly? he lost count, but of course, after the cops arrived and everyone ran off, he found himself at you doorstep, seeking you out like a lost puppy.

Minutes ticked by as you two bathed in dead silence, Damian wincing at the pain while you continued cleaning him up.
Meanwhile, a sense of frustration started brewing within him— you were being quieter than usual and your hands were *definitely* being harsher than necessary while tending on his battered face.

 
"Are you gonna keep sulking for long?" 
Damian grumbled through gritted teeth, his voice muffled by the tissue.
